turns.text: Today is gonna be the day that they're gonna throw it back to you
turns.zh: 今天就是他们要把那件事甩回给你的日子

turns.text: And by now, you should've somehow realised what you gotta do
turns.zh: 到现在，你总该多少明白自己该做什么了吧

turns.text: I don't believe that anybody feels the way I do about you now
turns.zh: 我不信现在有谁能像我这样对你动心

turns.text: And backbeat, the word is on the street that the fire in your heart is out
turns.zh: 街上传开了，说你心里的那团火已经灭了

turns.text: I'm sure you've heard it all before, but you never really had a doubt
turns.zh: 这话你肯定早就听腻了，可你从来没真正怀疑过

turns.text: I don't believe that anybody feels the way I do about you now
turns.zh: 我不信现在有谁能像我这样对你动心

turns.text: And all the roads we have to walk are winding
turns.zh: 我们要走的路啊，都是弯弯绕绕的

turns.text: And all the lights that lead us there are blinding
turns.zh: 那些引我们过去的光，晃得人睁不开眼

turns.text: There are many things that I would like to say to you, but I don't know how
turns.zh: 有好多话想对你说，可我不知道怎么开口

turns.text: Because maybe
turns.zh: 因为也许

turns.text: You're gonna be the one that saves me
turns.zh: 你就是那个会来救我的人

turns.text: And after all

turns.text: You're my wonderwall
